system.description: This thrown weapon explodes with shrapnel, concussive force, gas, or bright chemical light, and sounds. There are three types of grenades used by Stargate Phoenix: Flash-Bang grenades deal no damage but force every character within the blast to succeed at a Constitution save (DC 11+ attacker’s Proficiency bonus) or become blind and deaf for 1d6 rounds. Characters proficient in common weapons or explosives are considered proficient with grenades. A grenade is thrown at a point (see page 157) rather than at a target and goes off at the start of the throwing character’s next turn (or 6 seconds after release).
